name: Learn ByteChef by doing
description: New to ByteChef? This simple workflow is the perfect way to get started. In just a few minutes, you'll build your first automation: it fetches a random quote from the internet and logs it. It uses a manual trigger, so after importing it you click Run and see the result immediately. Swap in a Schedule trigger when you want it to run on its own.
shortDescription: Build your first ByteChef automation: fetch a random quote and log it, with one click.
keyFeatures: Manual trigger: runs the moment you click Run, no waiting and no credentials
HTTP GET request to a public API with JSON response parsing
Data reference between tasks using ByteChef expression syntax
Logger step for inspecting output without extra integrations
prerequisites: Internet access to reach the public quotes API
idealFor: Anyone new to ByteChef who wants a zero-configuration first workflow that demonstrates HTTP calls and task chaining, and runs immediately.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Run in the workflow editor.
Get a random quote: HTTP GET request to dummyjson.com/quotes/random returns a JSON object.
Log the quote: the Logger step prints the quote field from the HTTP response to the execution log.
